text:
Mia Chen: Quick sync — marketplace launch readiness + embargo coordination. Proposed publish: Tue May 12 10:00 PT (17:00Z). Need final assets, partner quote, legal signoff by EOD Thu. Who owns the landing slug and staging preview?

Samir Patel: I can own the landing slug + redirect. Samir to push preview to staging by tomorrow. Question: do we need partner-specific CTA or a unified CTA?

Laura Kim: Legal confirmed the partner quote language (minor edits). Laura: partner contact is andrew@cloudmate.io for final approval. We need the partner logo in SVG and a 1-sentence partner blurb by EOD Thurs.

Patrick O'Neill: Eng notes: marketplace listing ID is MKT-CLD-9472 (staging). Deployment window I'm reserving: 2025-05-12T17:00Z - 2025-05-12T17:30Z. We'll do a 5% canary for 15m then ramp. Need owners for smoke tests and a rollback tag.

Maria Gomez: Marketing assets: landing preview -> https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace/cloudmate-preview (private). Copy draft: "Redwood Inference + CloudMate: fast, private inference in your cloud." Draft partner quote (send to Andrew): "CloudMate is excited to offer Redwood-powered inference on CloudMate Marketplace — fast setup, predictable performance."

announce-bot: NOTE: embargo window set. Scheduled publish job pending confirmation for 2025-05-12T17:00Z. Add reaction :lock: if this is correct.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: pipeline run id: pipeline/marketplace/publish/1807654321. Command to trigger manual run:

```
# prod push (requires ops approval)
deploy pipeline/marketplace/publish --env prod --target MKT-CLD-9472
```
Samir Patel: Canary policy: route 5% of traffic to marketplace_public_v1 for first 15m, monitor latency, error-rate, and generation-quality alerts. Samir -> will own canary dashboard.

Patrick O'Neill: I'll own smoke tests (load: simple generate + embedding sanity). Rollback tag: rollback-marketplace-1807654321. If errors > 2% or latency > 2x baseline during canary, auto-roll back.

Laura Kim: Legal will sign off on final quote once Andrew replies. I pinged him. If no reply by Fri EOD, we use the agreed stub quote and mark partner approval pending in the listing.

Maria Gomez: Marketing checklist: hero image (SVG, 1200x600), partner quote, 3 bullets (use cases), GA tracking (utm params), and partner co-marketing blurb. I uploaded assets to the staging folder: gs://redwood-marketing/marketplace/cloudmate/preview.zip

Mia Chen: Action recap: Samir (landing slug + staging preview), Maria (final assets + GA tags), Laura (partner signoff), Patrick (deploy + canary + rollback), Samir (canary dashboard). Please drop a one-line confirm in this thread once your piece is done.

Samir Patel: Confirmed. I will push staging slug + enable redirect. :thumbsup:

Patrick O'Neill: Confirmed. Smoke tests scripted and will run during canary. :white_check_mark:

Maria Gomez: Assets uploaded and CTA copy finalized. Waiting on partner logo (SVG). :eyes:

Laura Kim: Sent legal signoff doc to Andrew. Will update here after reply. :email:

announce-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2025-05-12T16:00Z (1 hour before publish).

Mia Chen: Thanks all — one more ask: partner press embargo time must be coordinated with CloudMate PR. Laura, can you confirm embargo language aligns with them?

Laura Kim: Reached out to CloudMate PR and confirmed embargo alignment. They requested 30m heads-up before publish for internal comms. I'll send the heads-up at 16:30Z.

Samir Patel: Linking final checklist doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketplace/checklists/cloudmate-launch (private). Please add verification notes.

Patrick O'Neill: Ops note: if anything blocks automated publish we will do a manual cutover using the pipeline command above. Ops on call: @oncall-ops.

Mia Chen: Perfect. Final ask: post the final asset links and the partner signed quote in this thread when ready so marketing/legal can attach to the listing before publish. :rocket:

Maria Gomez: Will do.

Laura Kim: Will do.

Samir Patel: Done after staging push.

Patrick O'Neill: Standing by for the deploy window.

announce-bot: Publish scheduled: 2025-05-12T17:00Z -> will announce in #marketing and #announcements on success.

deploy-bot: Pipeline status: queued -> awaiting manual approval.

Mia Chen: Thanks team — closing sync.

Samir Patel: :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: :party-popper:
